hero.tagline: Where confusion becomes possibility, tension becomes direction, and change takes shape.

intro.solo: We help organisations in moments of transformation to decide with judgement. We turn strategy into solutions that endure.
intro.revealBody: Allowing us to see what isn't yet evident. Avoiding quick answers. Opening space to define something that truly makes sense for what is yet to come.
intro.p1: That place has no name in any service catalogue.
intro.p2: We have spent years building there.
intro.p3: We combine strategic design, human judgement and technology to help organisations make better decisions.
intro.p4: We turn strategy into validated products and services to activate sustainable cultural change.

liminal.title: Liminal Attitude
liminal.body1: Nothing new happens at the center. It is predictable, comfortable, and today, the fastest way to become irrelevant.
liminal.body2: That's why we chose to operate at the margins, between borders, between limits. That's where human truths live, and that's where we decided to stay.
liminal.body3: We work from that liminal space, between what is and what's yet to come. We do it by questioning the obvious and shifting focus, with judgment and human perspective.
liminal.quote: We inhabit the margin to live within change.
